limr.theme.description: Reader theme. The default uses the LiMR Playground palette and follows VS Code brightness.
limr.editingEnabled.description: Allow reader actions to modify the open Markdown document. Changes use VS Code undo/redo and normal Save/Auto Save.
limr.bodyFontFamily.description: Latin body font family. Empty uses the bundled Playground font: Noto Serif SC Variable.
limr.chineseFontFamily.description: Chinese body font family. Empty uses the body font (Playground Noto Serif SC Variable by default).
limr.otherFontFamily.description: Font family for other scripts. Empty uses the body font fallback.
limr.bodyFontSize.description: Latin body font size in pixels.
limr.chineseFontSize.description: Chinese body font size in pixels; 0 follows body size.
limr.otherFontSize.description: Other script font size in pixels; 0 follows body size.
limr.codeFontFamily.description: Code font family. Empty uses the bundled Playground font: LiMR Maple Mono NF CN.
limr.showSidebar.description: Show annotation sidebar when there is sufficient room.
limr.showSidebar.deprecation: Use `#limr.sidebarMode#` to choose always, only with content, or hidden. An existing false value remains effective until a sidebar mode is explicitly configured.
limr.sidebarMode.description: Choose when to reserve an annotation sidebar. Sidebars need sufficient editor width; narrow readers use annotation overlays. Without a sidebar, the article stays centered.
limr.sidebarMode.option.always: Always enabled: reserve sidebar space even when the document has no annotations.
limr.sidebarMode.option.content: Enable with content: reserve space only when annotations, footnotes, or other supported sidebar content exists (default). Highlights alone do not reserve space.
limr.sidebarMode.option.hidden: Disabled: never reserve sidebar space; read annotations in overlays.
limr.sidebarAutoCollapse.description: Automatically fold crowded annotation items in the sidebar. Turn off to lay out each item separately. This controls groups of cards, not the sidebar itself or the expansion of each card's body.
limr.syncScroll.description: Synchronize the source editor's visible range with the reader.
limr.tocMode.description: Table of contents: always includes a compact TOC on narrow screens; wide only shows the side rail; hidden omits it.
limr.typography.description: Default paragraph layout. Use Choose Typography for a persistent override on the current file.
limr.translationMode.description: Default translation display. Changing a paragraph creates a per-file preference and switches that file to paragraph mode.
limr.language.description: Reader and command dialog language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
limr.topBarButtons.description: Buttons displayed in the reader editor title. Hidden actions remain available in the Command Palette.
limr.bottomBarButtons.description: Items displayed in the VS Code status bar while a LiMR reader is active.
limr.previewButtonMode.description: Merged replaces the built-in Markdown preview buttons with one LiMR default button. Hold Alt (or Shift) for the built-in preview; the editor overflow menu lists both.
limr.skills.promptOnStartup.description: Offer to install the AI skill on first use in a workspace unless a global skill is already installed. Set at user or workspace scope to stop reminders.
limr.images.pathMode.description: How to resolve relative image paths. Configure at user or workspace scope. Explicit absolute paths and parent-directory references keep their precise locations; no filename-only or implicit public/static directory search is performed.
limr.images.pathMode.option.auto: Auto: try the Markdown file's directory first, then its containing workspace root (default).
limr.images.pathMode.option.file: File: resolve relative images only against the Markdown file's directory.
limr.images.pathMode.option.workspace: Workspace: resolve relative images against the containing workspace root.
limr.images.pathMode.option.folder: Fixed folder: use images.baseFolder; an empty folder does not trigger automatic guessing.
limr.images.baseFolder.description: Base directory for fixed-folder image mode. Accepts an absolute path, file URI, or ~ for the extension host's home. Relative directories are based on the containing workspace, or the Markdown directory when no workspace is open.
limr.images.searchPaths.description: Additional image directories, tried in listed order only after the selected path strategy fails; the first matching file wins. Uses the same directory formats as images.baseFolder. Empty by default; paths are appended without basename matching.
limr.plugins.enabled.description: Load reader styles and modules from the workspace and installed add-on extensions when the window is trusted.
limr.plugins.manifest.description: Workspace-relative plugin manifest. Stylesheet and module paths are relative to this file.
limr.previewButtonMode.option.merged: One preview button, default to LiMR
limr.syntaxHighlighting.enabled.descript: Add LiMR syntax colors in Markdown source editors (enabled by default). Changes apply immediately. Colors supported delimiters, tags and attributes while preserving existing Markdown and code highlighting.
limr.syntax.punctuation.description: Color of LiMR syntax punctuation in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.tag.description: Color of LiMR tags, directives and callout types in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.attribute.description: Color of LiMR attribute names in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.value.description: Color of LiMR attribute values in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.annotation.description: Color of LiMR active annotation boundaries and inline footnote markers in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.highlight.description: Color of LiMR inline highlight delimiters in Markdown source editors.
limr.syntax.math.description: Color of LiMR math delimiters in Markdown source editors.
limr.loadingMode.description: How large Markdown files become available. Progress appears below the editor tabs and in the VS Code status bar. Previews are limited to 75 MiB and 60 seconds per load.
limr.tableLayout.enabled.description: Optimize table column widths and long cell content. Enabled by default. Disable to use native table layout and reduce measurement work for long tables.
limr.loadingMode.option.blocking: Finish loading the complete document before reading.
limr.loadingMode.option.progressive: Preview first (default): show a read-only opening while parsing continues in the background. Some plugins require complete loading.
limr.markdownOpenMode.description: Default behavior when opening Markdown files. None preserves VS Code behavior. Explicit source actions remain available.
limr.markdownOpenMode.option.sideBySide: Open the source and LiMR side by side
limr.markdownLinkMode.description: Behavior for links to other Markdown files. Reuses another editor group when available. Current-reader navigation supports mouse back/forward buttons and Alt+arrow keys.
limr.markdownLinkMode.option.currentRead: Navigate in the current LiMR reader
limr.markdownLinkMode.option.besideReade: Open LiMR in another group (current group in single-reader mode)
limr.markdownLinkMode.option.besideEdito: Open the default text editor in another group
limr.markdownLinkMode.option.editorAndRe: Open the source beside the reader and navigate LiMR; back restores the previous files
limr.markdownLinkMode.option.smart: Smart: synchronize a source/reader pair for the same document; otherwise navigate only the current reader
limr.singleReader.description: Reuse one LiMR reader, closing other saved reader tabs after opening. Unsaved tabs are retained to protect edits.
limr.contentAlignment.description: When the annotation sidebar is absent and a side TOC is visible, center the article in the whole reader window or in the space to the right of the TOC.
limr.contentAlignment.option.remaining: Center in the space to the right of the TOC
